description: Synthetic, non-production contract review benchmark for deterministic regression testing. It is not a legal dataset and does not measure legal correctness.

policies.name: Corporate Limitation of Liability Standard
policies.text: Company requires all vendor contracts to cap aggregate liability at twelve (12) months of fees paid under the agreement. Unlimited or uncapped liability is not permitted.

policies.name: Term and Termination Guidelines
policies.text: Vendor agreements must provide at least thirty (30) days' prior written notice before termination for convenience.

policies.name: Vendor Payment Terms Standard
policies.text: All vendor invoices must be paid within thirty (30) days of receipt.

policies.name: Vendor Data Protection Requirement
policies.text: All vendor contracts must include data protection obligations for personal data, including prompt notice of any data breach.

contracts.name: Acme Master Services Agreement v1
contracts.text:
1. Limitation of Liability
The vendor's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall be unlimited for any direct or indirect damages.
2. Termination
Company may terminate this Agreement for convenience with fifteen (15) days' prior written notice.
3. Payment Terms
Customer shall pay all undisputed invoices within sixty (60) days of receipt.
4. Confidentiality
Each party shall protect the other party's confidential information using reasonable care.

contracts.name: Beta SaaS Agreement v1
contracts.text:
1. Limitation of Liability
Vendor's aggregate liability shall be limited to twenty-four (24) months of fees paid.
2. Termination
Either party may terminate for material breach with thirty (30) days' prior written notice.
3. Payment Terms
Customer shall pay invoices within thirty (30) days.
4. Governing Law
This Agreement is governed by the laws of Delaware.
